title: TIME JUMP — 22:30 CST: The Line Reaches the County

fields.scenarioTitle: Rain-Wrapped — Night Tornado Warning & Shelter Timing
fields.narration: The time is now 22:30 CST on Friday, December 11, 2026. The leading edge of the line has reached the Brennan County line west of the Clarks River bottoms. On the KPAH radar loop, which is simulated case data, a couplet is tightening about 15 miles southwest of Corwin. Heavy rain now covers Ashford, and the lights are flickering in Corwin. At Ridgeline Distribution, the 22:30 break has just started, and workers are heading out to the parking lot. The safe rooms are in whatever state your earlier decision left them. If you ordered them open, the Schools Facilities Director is at the Ashford Middle School doors and the Corwin custodian has the lights on at the Corwin Community Center. If you did not, both buildings are dark and locked. 911 has three calls on hold. All of them are trees down on rural roads, and the console is filling up. BrennanAlert, NOAA Weather Radio and both siren encoders, at Position 2 and in the EOC, are working. Sirens N-07 and N-11 are still out. No warning is in effect for Brennan County yet. Before anything else happens, each role will report its current status. THIS IS AN EXERCISE.
worldState: Clock is 22:30 CST, Friday, December 11, 2026. The PDS Tornado Watch is still in effect until 04:00.
The leading edge of the line is at the western county line, west of the Clarks River bottoms. It is moving northeast at about 60 mph.
KPAH radar (simulated case data) shows a tightening couplet about 15 miles southwest of Corwin. No tornado warning has been issued for Brennan County.
Heavy rain covers Ashford. Power is flickering in Corwin. Outages are brief and nothing is down for good yet.

Ridgeline Distribution, Corwin Industrial Park (KY 80): the 22:30 break has started for the overnight shift of up to 310. Workers are walking to their cars unless the supervisor has already acted on your earlier answer. The building's refuge areas are in the restroom cores.

Safe rooms: if you ordered them open at or before the 21:45 call, Ashford Middle School (300, east entrance) has its doors unlocked and the Corwin Community Center (300) is lit and open. If you did not, both are dark and locked. Ashford Middle needs 20 minutes to open at night, and Corwin needs 15 minutes.
The Clarks River parks have only what you told them: Pine Hollow (shelter for 60), Riverbend and Shady Acres (no shelter), about 1,100 residents in all.
911 overnight floor (two telecommunicators, one supervisor): three calls are holding, all trees down on rural roads, and call volume is rising.
BrennanAlert (about 14,200 subscribers) is up, and its WX templates are in the console. A countywide voice call takes up to 12 minutes to complete.
NOAA Weather Radio (Paducah transmitter) is up. The siren encoders at Position 2 and in the EOC are both up.
Sirens: 44 of 46 are ready. North zone N-07 (Pine Hollow) and N-11 (Clarks River bridge) are still out of service.
fields.facilitatorNote: Go round the room before moving on. The EMD states which safe rooms are open or opening, what the Clarks River parks were told, and Ridgeline's plan for the 22:30 break. The EMD should confirm that the WO has the BrennanAlert WX tornado template ready (zone, expiry, 'take shelter now', safe room status), that the SUP has Position 2 ready to sound the zones inside any polygon without waiting, and that the PIO has the safe room message lined up with Channel 6. If the safe rooms were not ordered open, point out that opening them now cannot finish before about 22:45–22:50, which is after the line's expected arrival.

instructorNote: This status check comes right before the first warning. It shows whether the earlier calls on the safe rooms, the Clarks River parks and Ridgeline turned into actions, and whether the BrennanAlert, siren and message templates are ready. Watch for roles that assume someone else has told Pine Hollow or Ridgeline, and for anyone planning to wait for the warning before preparing the BrennanAlert message.
